what: The audit of the v0 system that motivated this rebuild.

provenance.note: v0's sources were deleted from the tree in P0 and survive only at the tag (plan A-1). These figures are therefore a record of a past measurement, not an output of the current pipeline, and they are the only numbers in the README of that kind. They are committed so that FR-902 holds literally — every figure on the page resolves to a file — rather than by an exception carved out for them.

holdout.defect: Two races is not a holdout. Every metric below is indistinguishable from noise, which is the second of the two root causes the rebuild addresses.

leakage.defect: Computed from the actual weather of the race being predicted, so every v0 metric below is inflated by knowing whether it rained.

verdict: v0 lost to a one-line baseline on five of six metrics, while reading the race's own weather and being scored on forty rows.
